programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: In Norfolk, a two-for-one spot where a butcher stacks sandwiches by day and a chef fires up ramen and sticky wings at night; a German-Swiss joint in the middle of Maui, Hawaii serves rouladen and old-fashioned apple strudel.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: In Los Angeles, a late-night spot serves breakfast with a twist, like drunken French toast; in Columbus, Ohio, a funky joint serves creative combos like brisket on corn cakes; in Phoenix, a barbecue stop smokes up prime rib and pork belly dumplings.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: In Chicago, a saucy spot mashes up Latin and Asian with a unique paella and posole; a comfort food joint in Seattle fires things up with Nashville hot chicken; a place in Kona, Hawaii, mixes island and mainland with guava ribs and tropical pizza.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: On this trip, Guy Fieri grabs a fistful of righteous hand-held toppings starting with a kolach café in Salt Lake City cooking up their Czech specialties with some sweetness and comfort.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: Hearty helpings of comfort include a soul food spot dishing out Southern seafood and killer fried chicken in Atlanta.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: Grub infused with international flavors; a spot in Wilmington, Del., puts Thai into sausage and Cuban into sandwiches; in Kauai, there's a Tiki joint cooking up Hawaiian flair; a Lebanese place in San Diego is serving authentic specialties.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: A Southwest-Middle Eastern quick stop slinging the shawarma and salmon souvlaki in Santa Fe; a funky joint serving up outrageous Scandinavian specialties in Kansas City; in El Paso, a tortilla factory turning out top-notch tamales and tostadas.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: Guy Fieri's diving into all kinds of 'cue on this trip; in Ottawa, Canada, a funky chicken joint cranking the rotisserie; in Burlington, Vt., a place smokin' their wings; Texas-style spot in Richmond, Va.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: In Logan, Utah, a joint serving Louisiana specialties like blackened chicken pasta and a marrow butter burger; in Portland, Oregon, a place putting a vegan spin on Israeli flavors; in Denver, a pizza eatery all about Detroit-style pies.

programs.desc: Guy Fieri digs into both meat and sweet, starting in Sioux Falls, S.D., where a market-butcher eatery is serving a culinary extravaganza; in Fargo, N.D., a bakery café makes sticky pecan rolls and a savory French pastry dish.
